title: Aurum Finance
tagline: Interest bearing platform for esports and streamers
description: Aurum is decentralized no-loss prediction market for Eports, allowing fans to stake their tokens to a pool and earn a reward when they make a winning bet. The system works by pooling all of the funds for a given game, putting them to generate yield thanks to pooltogether, and then return the original funds + the total yield of the pool to the users who made the right choice, while simply sending back the original funds to the loosing side of the bet.
how_its_made: Aurum uses Chainlink oracles to gather off-chain data through external APIs about upcoming tournaments/matches and to inform the smart contracts when one of these has come to a fruition. The funds are pooled using Pooltogether and the yearn.finance pool to generate the yield to be rewarded to the winning side.
